description: Manual test scripts for Factory Inventory 0.2.0 Beta: the server, the desktop app and the phone app.

suites.name: Installation and setup
suites.description: Installing the server and the apps, the first login, connecting an app.

cases.title: Install the server on a clean PC
cases.preconditions: A Windows 11 PC without Factory Inventory. The server installer of the build under test.

steps.action: Run FactoryInventoryServer-<version>-Setup.exe and follow it to the end.
steps.expected: Windows asks for permission once. The installer finishes without an error and offers to open the settings program.

steps.action: Let the last page open the window "Factory Inventory Server".
steps.expected: The window opens. Step 1 says that the server is running.

steps.action: Look at the firewall line of the window.
steps.expected: It says the server can be reached from this network, or offers "Allow Through the Firewall" - it never shows an error.

steps.action: Open Services (services.msc) and look for the server's service.
steps.expected: The service is there, running, and set to start automatically.

cases.title: Make the first login in the settings program
cases.preconditions: A freshly installed server on which nobody has made a login.

steps.action: In the window "Factory Inventory Server", type a user name and a password of four characters, the same twice, and press Create Login.
steps.expected: The window says the password is too short; no login is made.

steps.action: Type a longer password, but two different ones, and press Create Login.
steps.expected: The window says that the two do not match; no login is made.

steps.action: Type the same good password twice and press Create Login.
steps.expected: It says "Done" with the user name. The form is replaced by "Add Another Login".

steps.action: Close the window and open it again from the Start menu.
steps.expected: It shows that a login exists and does not ask for the first one again.

cases.title: Install the desktop app and log in
cases.preconditions: A server with a login. The desktop installer of the same build.

steps.action: Run FactoryInventory-<version>-Setup.exe to the end and start Factory Inventory.
steps.expected: The app starts. It finds the server on the same PC or asks for its address under Server > Server Settings.

steps.action: Press Test Connection in Server Settings.
steps.expected: It says that the server answers and to log in.

steps.action: Log in with the user made in the settings program.
steps.expected: The main window shows the tables in the tree on the left. The status bar says who is logged in.

steps.action: Open Help > About Factory Inventory.
steps.expected: It shows the app's build time and the server's version and build time, with no sentence about the server being older.

cases.title: Connect a phone with the setup code
cases.preconditions: The phone is in the same network as the server. The phone package of the same build is installed.

steps.action: On the desktop choose Server > Connect a Phone...
steps.expected: A QR code is shown with the server's name, its address(es) and the certificate's fingerprint.

steps.action: On the phone open the menu, Server Settings, and tap Scan Setup Code. Allow the camera and scan the code.
steps.expected: Right under the button it says the phone is set up for the server and to tap Save. Address and certificate are filled in.

steps.action: Tap Save and log in.
steps.expected: The list of tables is shown. No certificate warning appears.

steps.action: Scan a QR code that is not a setup code (any other product's).
steps.expected: The page says that this is no setup code. The address and certificate stay as they were.

cases.title: Install over an older version
cases.preconditions: A PC with an older version of the server installed and data in it (a few parts, a login).

steps.action: Note a part's name and stock in the old version. Run the new server installer.
steps.expected: It says that an earlier version is installed and that it replaces it.

steps.action: Press OK and let it finish.
steps.expected: It finishes without asking to uninstall first. The settings program says the server is running.

steps.action: Log in from the new desktop app with the old login.
steps.expected: The login works; the part and its stock are as noted.

steps.action: Open Help > About.
steps.expected: The server's version is the new one.

cases.title: Uninstalling keeps the data unless told otherwise
cases.preconditions: An installed server with data. A copy of nothing is needed: the first run keeps the data.

steps.action: In the settings program choose Uninstall the Server...
steps.expected: A dialog opens on "Keep my data (recommended)" with Uninstall enabled and Cancel as the default.

steps.action: Choose "Delete my data too" without ticking the box.
steps.expected: Uninstall is disabled until the box "it cannot be brought back" is ticked.

steps.action: Go back to "Keep my data" and uninstall.
steps.expected: The server is removed. The data folder C:\ProgramData\FactoryInventory\Server is still there with the database and backups.

steps.action: Install the server again and log in.
steps.expected: The old login and all records are there.

cases.title: An app that is newer than the server says so
cases.preconditions: A server of an older build than the apps.

steps.action: Start the desktop app and log in.
steps.expected: A box and a line of the log say that the server is older than the app and how to update it. The app goes on working.

steps.action: Open Help > About.
steps.expected: The sentence is shown there too, in the error color.

steps.action: Log in on the phone.
steps.expected: A dialog says the same once, and the first page keeps the sentence at its top.

suites.name: Logins, users and rights
suites.description: Who may get in and what they may do.

cases.title: A wrong password is refused and slows down
cases.preconditions: The server has a user.

steps.action: Log in with the right name and a wrong password.
steps.expected: The login dialog says the name or password is wrong and stays open.

steps.action: Repeat a wrong password six times in a row.
steps.expected: After the fifth the server says to wait before trying again.

steps.action: Wait half a minute and log in with the right password.
steps.expected: The login works.

cases.title: A group's rights limit what a user sees and may do
cases.preconditions: The server is running and you are logged in as an administrator.

steps.action: Open Server > Users and Groups... Add a group "Viewers" with only View on Parts.
steps.expected: The group is listed.

steps.action: Add a user "viewer" in that group, log out, and log in as "viewer".
steps.expected: The tree shows Parts; the other tables say "(no access)".

steps.action: Select a part and look at Edit, and at Data > Delete Selected.
steps.expected: The part cannot be changed or deleted: Edit does nothing or is disabled, Delete is disabled.

steps.action: Log out and back in as the administrator, and delete the user and the group.
steps.expected: Both are gone after the question.

cases.title: The last administrator cannot be removed
cases.preconditions: Exactly one administrator exists.

steps.action: In Users and Groups select the only administrator and press Delete.
steps.expected: It is refused, and the reason - the last administrator - stays shown.

steps.action: Try to take that user out of the Administrators group.
steps.expected: Refused in the same way.

cases.title: Change your own password
cases.preconditions: Logged in as any user.

steps.action: Choose Server > Change Password... and type the old password wrong.
steps.expected: It is refused; the password is unchanged.

steps.action: Type the old password right and a new one twice.
steps.expected: It says the password was changed.

steps.action: Log out and log in with the new password.
steps.expected: The login works; the old password no longer does.

cases.title: What is done to the server is written into the audit log
cases.preconditions: The server is running and you are logged in as an administrator.

steps.action: Add a user, then change the user's display name.
steps.expected: Both are stored.

steps.action: Open Server > Audit Log...
steps.expected: The newest lines are "user changed" and "user added" with who did it, when and from which address.

steps.action: Read the details of the lines.
steps.expected: No password, token or key appears anywhere in the log.

cases.title: An administrator can take over a connection when none is free
cases.preconditions: A server on the Free edition (one desktop, one phone). A second PC with the desktop app.

steps.action: Log in on the first PC as an ordinary user and leave the app open.
steps.expected: Logged in.

steps.action: On the second PC log in as another ordinary user.
steps.expected: Refused: no connection is free. No offer to disconnect anybody.

steps.action: On the second PC log in as an administrator.
steps.expected: The dialog asks whether to disconnect the first user's desktop app, with a button Disconnect and Log In.

steps.action: Press Disconnect and Log In.
steps.expected: The administrator is logged in. The first PC is asked to log in again. The audit log has a line for it.

suites.name: Parts and stock
suites.description: Parts, their lots, the history of the stock, counts.

cases.title: Add, change and delete a part
cases.preconditions: The server is running and you are logged in as an administrator.

steps.action: Add a part "QA Bolt" with part number QA-1 and unit "each".
steps.expected: It appears in the list and the tree, with today as its date added.

steps.action: Select it, press Edit, change the description and press Save.
steps.expected: The form is read-only again and shows the new description.

steps.action: Press Edit, change the name and press Cancel.
steps.expected: The stored name is back.

steps.action: Delete the part.
steps.expected: A plain question is asked; after Delete the part is gone from the list.

cases.title: Stock in lots with four locations
cases.preconditions: A part "QA Bolt" exists.

steps.action: Open the part, press Edit, go to the Inventory tab and Add Stock: 100 at Facility "Plant", Shelf "A", unit cost 0.10.
steps.expected: A lot of 100 is listed with value 10.00 in the server's currency.

steps.action: Add a second lot of 50 at Shelf "B", unit cost 0.20.
steps.expected: Two lots; the totals say 150 on hand and a value of 20.00.

steps.action: Select the first lot and press Use; type 30.
steps.expected: The lot shows 70; the total 120.

steps.action: Try to Use 500 from a lot.
steps.expected: Refused: not more than is there can be used.

cases.title: Every change of a quantity is in the stock history
cases.preconditions: The part of the case before, with its two lots and one use.

steps.action: On the Inventory tab press History...
steps.expected: Three lines, the newest first: used -30, and two "added" lines, each with before and after, location and who.

steps.action: Close it, press Edit and move a lot to another shelf without changing its quantity.
steps.expected: The lot shows the new shelf.

steps.action: Open History... again.
steps.expected: No new line: only changes of a quantity are movements.

cases.title: A whole-unit part takes no fractions; a measured part does
cases.preconditions: The server is running and you are logged in as an administrator.

steps.action: Add a part counted in whole units and try to add stock of 2.5.
steps.expected: Refused with a sentence about whole numbers.

steps.action: Add a part "QA Glue" with unit "ml" and the box for whole units unticked. Add stock of 2.5.
steps.expected: Accepted: the lot shows 2.5 ml.

cases.title: The names of the four location fields can be changed
cases.preconditions: The server is running and you are logged in as an administrator.

steps.action: Open Server > Inventory Location Names... and call the third field "Rack". Save.
steps.expected: It is stored.

steps.action: Open a part's Inventory tab and the dialog that adds stock.
steps.expected: The column and the field are called "Rack".

steps.action: Open the same part's stock on the phone.
steps.expected: The field is called "Rack" there too.

steps.action: Press Use Defaults in the dialog and save.
steps.expected: The names are Facility / Room / Shelf / Bin again.

cases.title: A stock count puts the books right in one step
cases.preconditions: A part with two lots (say 70 and 50). No lot is reserved.

steps.action: Open Data > Stock Count... and search for the part.
steps.expected: Its lots are listed with what the books say and an empty Counted column.

steps.action: Type 68 for the first lot and 50 for the second. Press Post Count...
steps.expected: The question says 2 lots were counted and 1 differs.

steps.action: Confirm.
steps.expected: The sentence under the list names the difference (70 -> 68). The list reloads with 68.

steps.action: Open the part's stock history.
steps.expected: One new line "adjusted -2" with the note "Stock count"; the lot that was right has none.

cases.title: Deleting a part says what goes with it
cases.preconditions: A part with stock that is also in a product.

steps.action: Select the part and delete it.
steps.expected: The question lists what goes along: its stock rows, its history, and that it is taken out of the product.

steps.action: Press Cancel.
steps.expected: Nothing is deleted.

steps.action: Delete again and confirm with Delete All of It.
steps.expected: The part is gone; the product no longer lists it.

cases.title: Search and Show More in a long list
cases.preconditions: More than 40 parts exist.

steps.action: Open Parts.
steps.expected: The list shows the first 32 and says "32 of N"; a Show More button stands under it.

steps.action: Press Show More.
steps.expected: As many again are added; the count follows.

steps.action: Type two words that are in one part's name and number into the search box.
steps.expected: A moment later only the parts with both words are listed, with "N found".

steps.action: Clear the search.
steps.expected: The first page is back.

suites.name: Products and variants
suites.description: Products, what they are made of, their variants, kits, suppliers.

cases.title: A product and its parts
cases.preconditions: Parts "QA Bolt" and "QA Plate" exist.

steps.action: Add a product "QA Bracket" with a retail price of 12.50.
steps.expected: It is listed, with the price shown in the server's currency.

steps.action: Edit it; on the Parts tab add 4 x QA Bolt and 1 x QA Plate.
steps.expected: Both are listed with quantity and unit.

steps.action: Try to add QA Bolt a second time.
steps.expected: It is not offered any more (or refused): a product has a part once.

steps.action: Open QA Bolt and look at its Used In tab.
steps.expected: It lists QA Bracket with a quantity of 4.

cases.title: A product cannot contain itself
cases.preconditions: Products "QA Kit" and "QA Case" exist.

steps.action: Put QA Case into QA Kit (the Products tab).
steps.expected: Stored.

steps.action: Try to put QA Kit into QA Case.
steps.expected: Refused, with the way round by name: "... would contain itself: ...". The dialog stays open.

cases.title: Variants: one product in several colours
cases.preconditions: A product "QA Hook".

steps.action: Edit it; on the Variants tab add "Red" as the attributes.
steps.expected: OK stays disabled and the dialog says how an attribute is written (Colour=Red).

steps.action: Add "Colour=Red, Size=M".
steps.expected: The variant is listed.

steps.action: Add "size=m, colour=RED".
steps.expected: Refused: the product has that variant already.

steps.action: Press Add Combinations... and type "Colour: Red, Blue; Size: S, M".
steps.expected: A box says 3 variants were added and 1 was there already; four variants are listed.

cases.title: Stock is kept by variant
cases.preconditions: QA Hook with its four variants.

steps.action: On its Inventory tab add 5 as "Colour=Red, Size=M" and 2 as "Colour=Blue, Size=M".
steps.expected: Two lots; with "Show attributes as columns" ticked there is a Colour and a Size column.

steps.action: Untick "Show attributes as columns".
steps.expected: One column "Variant" instead. The choice is remembered when the app is started again.

steps.action: Look at QA Hook in the Products list.
steps.expected: In stock 7, and "Stock by variant" says Red M: 5, Blue M: 2.

steps.action: Try to delete the variant Colour=Red, Size=M.
steps.expected: Refused: there is stock of it.

cases.title: Whom a product is bought from
cases.preconditions: A product and two suppliers exist.

steps.action: Edit the product; on the Suppliers tab add the first supplier with its number and a price.
steps.expected: Listed with phone and e-mail of the supplier.

steps.action: Add the second supplier; then try to add the first again.
steps.expected: The second is listed; the first is not offered again.

steps.action: Take the first supplier off the product.
steps.expected: The question says the supplier itself stays. It is still in the Suppliers table.

cases.title: The Free edition holds 25 products
cases.preconditions: A server without a license, with fewer than 25 products.

steps.action: Open Help > About.
steps.expected: Edition: Free; "At most 25 products".

steps.action: Add products until there are 25.
steps.expected: All are accepted. Variants do not count.

steps.action: Add a twenty-sixth.
steps.expected: Refused with a sentence naming the limit of the Free edition.

suites.name: The stock of products
suites.description: Finished products on the shelf: making, taking apart, promoting parts, stock levels.

cases.title: Make products of their parts
cases.preconditions: QA Bracket = 4 bolts + 1 plate; 40 bolts at 0.10 and 3 plates at 1.00 in stock.

steps.action: On QA Bracket's Inventory tab press Make...
steps.expected: The dialog says what one takes of each part and that up to 3 can be made.

steps.action: Type 4.
steps.expected: The plate line says "not enough"; there is no Make to press.

steps.action: Type 2, give a location and press Make.
steps.expected: A lot of 2 appears at the cost of the parts (1.40 each). 8 bolts and 2 plates have left their stock.

steps.action: Open the bolts' stock history.
steps.expected: A line "used -8" with the note "Made into 2 x QA Bracket".

cases.title: Take apart what was made
cases.preconditions: The lot of 2 brackets made in the case before, not reserved.

steps.action: Select the lot and press Take Apart...
steps.expected: The dialog says 2 can be taken apart.

steps.action: Type 3.
steps.expected: Refused: there are only 2 in this lot.

steps.action: Type 1 and confirm.
steps.expected: The sentence under the list says which parts went back (4 bolts, 1 plate). The lot shows 1.

steps.action: Select a lot that was typed in with Add Stock.
steps.expected: Take Apart... is disabled, and its tool tip says why.

cases.title: Make a part a product
cases.preconditions: A counted part "QA Pin" with 10 free in stock.

steps.action: On the part's Inventory tab press Make It a Product...
steps.expected: A dialog explains it; "Move the stock that is free" is ticked.

steps.action: Confirm.
steps.expected: The browser shows a new product "QA Pin" made of one QA Pin, with 10 in stock. The part's free stock is 0.

steps.action: Choose Data > Make Products of Parts... and filter for a part that is already a product.
steps.expected: It is not among the candidates.

cases.title: A product's stock level puts it on the Make List
cases.preconditions: QA Bracket with 1 free on the shelf and parts for 1 more.

steps.action: Edit QA Bracket and type "lots" as its Stock level.
steps.expected: Save stays disabled.

steps.action: Type 4 and save. Open Data > Make List...
steps.expected: QA Bracket is listed: free 1, level 4, below by 3, to make 3, can make now 1, and the part it is short of.

steps.action: Select it and press Make...; accept the quantity filled in.
steps.expected: It makes 1. The list reloads: free 2, to make 2, can make now 0.

steps.action: Tick "Also the products there are enough of".
steps.expected: Products at or above their level are listed too.

cases.title: The Inventory tab says what is available to sell
cases.preconditions: A product with free stock and parts for more.

steps.action: Open the product's Inventory tab.
steps.expected: Under the summary: "Available to sell: N - x free on the shelf, and y more can be made of the parts in stock."

steps.action: Reserve all its parts for an assembly, or use them up, and refresh.
steps.expected: It says "what is free on the shelf; no more can be made of the parts in stock."

suites.name: Assemblies and batches
suites.description: Templates, reserving and building, substitutes, batches.

cases.title: An assembly template and what a build costs
cases.preconditions: Parts "QA Frame" (to make), "QA Bolt" (stock at 0.10) and "QA Plate" (stock at 1.00).

steps.action: Add an assembly template "QA Frame recipe" that makes QA Frame.
steps.expected: Stored; Makes cannot be changed afterwards.

steps.action: On its Parts tab add 6 bolts and 2 plates.
steps.expected: Listed.

steps.action: Open the Cost tab.
steps.expected: "Cost of one: 2.60", with the note that it is estimated from the average cost of the stock.

steps.action: Try to put QA Frame itself into the template.
steps.expected: Refused: a part cannot be made from itself.

cases.title: Reserve, release and build an assembly
cases.preconditions: The template above; stock for at least 2 frames.

steps.action: Add an assembly "QA Frames" of that template, quantity 2. Open its Build tab.
steps.expected: Status Planned; the parts needed are 12 bolts and 4 plates.

steps.action: Press Reserve Parts.
steps.expected: Status Reserved. The parts' lots show the amounts as reserved.

steps.action: Press Release, then Reserve Parts again, then Build... and give a location.
steps.expected: It warns that a build cannot be undone. Afterwards: status Built, a new lot of 2 frames at 2.60 each.

steps.action: Open the bolts' stock history.
steps.expected: A line "used -12" with the note "Assembly QA Frames".

cases.title: Reserving is all or nothing
cases.preconditions: An assembly that needs more of one part than is free.

steps.action: Press Reserve Parts.
steps.expected: Refused: "Not everything is in stock, so nothing was reserved." with the part, what is needed and what is free.

steps.action: Look at the lots of the other parts.
steps.expected: Nothing of them is reserved.

cases.title: Use a substitute part
cases.preconditions: A template with a part "Bolt, stainless" and a substitute "Bolt, zinc" on its Substitutes tab; a planned assembly of it.

steps.action: On the assembly's Build tab select the line of the stainless bolt and press Substitute...
steps.expected: The dialog says how much is needed and lists the zinc bolt with what is free.

steps.action: Press Use It.
steps.expected: The line reads "Bolt, zinc (instead of Bolt, stainless)".

steps.action: Reserve the parts.
steps.expected: The zinc bolts are reserved. Substitute... is now disabled.

cases.title: A batch reserves and builds several assemblies as one
cases.preconditions: Three planned assemblies; stock for all three.

steps.action: Add a batch "QA Run". Open its Run tab and press Add Assemblies...; filter "QA*" and add the three.
steps.expected: The dialog closes and the Run tab lists the three with what they need together.

steps.action: Press Reserve All.
steps.expected: All three are reserved; the batch says Reserved.

steps.action: Press Build All... and give a location.
steps.expected: All three are built at the same moment into that place.

cases.title: A batch that is short reserves nothing
cases.preconditions: A batch of two assemblies; stock for the first only.

steps.action: Press Reserve All.
steps.expected: Refused, naming the assembly that is short: "... Nothing was reserved for the batch."

steps.action: Open the first assembly.
steps.expected: It is still Planned: it kept nothing.

cases.title: Clone a template and an assembly
cases.preconditions: A template with parts; an assembly that is reserved.

steps.action: Select the template and choose Data > Clone Selected.
steps.expected: A template "... (copy)" is selected, with the same parts.

steps.action: Clone the reserved assembly.
steps.expected: The clone is Planned, in no batch, with nothing reserved.

suites.name: Machines and scheduling
suites.description: Machines, their status, what a job asks of them, machine time, the schedule.

cases.title: Take a machine offline and bring it back
cases.preconditions: A machine "QA Printer".

steps.action: On its Status tab press Set Offline... and leave the reason empty.
steps.expected: OK is disabled: a reason is needed.

steps.action: Type a reason and confirm.
steps.expected: It says the machine is offline; the history has a line with the reason, who and when.

steps.action: Press Set Online...
steps.expected: A reason is optional. The machine is online and the history has two lines.

cases.title: Only a machine that fits can run a job
cases.preconditions: Two machines with the attribute Nozzle: 0.4 and 0.6. A planned assembly.

steps.action: On the assembly's Required Attributes tab add Nozzle = 0.4.
steps.expected: Stored; the dialog offered the name and its values to pick.

steps.action: On the Machines tab press Add Machine...
steps.expected: Only the 0.4 machine is offered, and a line says so.

steps.action: With the 0.4 machine put down, try to change the requirement to 0.6.
steps.expected: Refused: the machine put down has Nozzle = 0.4.

cases.title: Machine time is part of what a job cost
cases.preconditions: A machine with an hourly rate of 10.00, put down for an assembly.

steps.action: Edit the machine entry: setup 0.5, run 2, teardown 0.5.
steps.expected: The list shows 3 hours and a cost of 30.00.

steps.action: Open the assembly's Build tab.
steps.expected: The total says "including 30.00 of machine time".

steps.action: Open Data > Machine Time... for this year.
steps.expected: The machine is listed with its hours and cost.

cases.title: Schedule two jobs on one machine
cases.preconditions: Two assemblies, each with the same machine put down for 4 hours.

steps.action: On the first assembly's Schedule tab choose the machine, set tomorrow 09:00 and press Schedule.
steps.expected: "Scheduled on ... from 09:00 to 13:00 (4 h)."

steps.action: Schedule the second on the same machine at 10:00.
steps.expected: Refused: the machine is busy then, with the job and its times.

steps.action: Press Next Free Time for the second and schedule it.
steps.expected: It is scheduled from 13:00.

steps.action: Open Data > Machine Schedule...
steps.expected: Both jobs are listed by start under the machine.

cases.title: The machine options of a template
cases.preconditions: A template with a machine model on its Machine Models tab (times filled in) and a machine of that model with a rate.

steps.action: On the template's Cost tab press Machine Options...
steps.expected: A row for the model with hours, machine time, parts, total and per piece; the cheapest is selected.

steps.action: Set "Pieces in one run" to 5.
steps.expected: Setup and teardown count once, the run time five times; the total and per piece follow.

steps.action: Press Plan Assembly... and accept the name.
steps.expected: An assembly for 5 is planned with the model's machine put down at the template's times.

cases.title: Import a sliced file
cases.preconditions: A sliced export (.gcode.3mf) of two plates, or a single plate's .gcode. A machine of the printer's model.

steps.action: Choose File > Import Sliced File... and pick the file.
steps.expected: The dialog shows the project, the printer model chosen, the filaments with their grams and one row per plate with its hours.

steps.action: Press Import.
steps.expected: A template per plate is made, each making a part of its own, with the filament as a part in grams and the print time as the run time.

steps.action: Open a project file that was only saved, not sliced.
steps.expected: It says the file was not sliced and to export the sliced file.

suites.name: Customer orders
suites.description: Orders, reserving, shipping in full and in part, invoices, shortages.

cases.title: An order with lines and a total
cases.preconditions: A customer and a product with a retail price of 12.50.

steps.action: Add a customer order for the customer. Edit it; on the Lines tab add 3 of the product.
steps.expected: The unit price starts as 12.50; the line total is 37.50.

steps.action: Open the Stock tab.
steps.expected: It lists what the order needs against what is free, and the order total 37.50.

steps.action: Add the same product a second time.
steps.expected: Refused: an order has a product once (per variant).

cases.title: Reserve and ship an order
cases.preconditions: An open order whose stock is all there.

steps.action: Press Reserve Stock.
steps.expected: Status Reserved; the lots show the amounts reserved for the order.

steps.action: Try to change a line.
steps.expected: Refused: the order's stock is reserved.

steps.action: Press Ship... and accept all that is left.
steps.expected: It warns that shipping cannot be undone. Status Shipped, with the date. The stock has left.

cases.title: Ship an order in parts
cases.preconditions: An order with a line of 4 and stock for all.

steps.action: Press Ship... and type 1 for the line.
steps.expected: The heading says the order is partly shipped; the Lines tab shows Shipped 1.

steps.action: Press Ship... and type 5.
steps.expected: Refused: only 3 are left to ship.

steps.action: Ship the remaining 3.
steps.expected: Status Shipped.

steps.action: Press Print... > Invoice...
steps.expected: Two invoices to choose from, with different numbers; the newest is selected.

cases.title: An order takes finished products first
cases.preconditions: A product with 2 finished on the shelf and parts for more. An order for 3.

steps.action: Open the order's Stock tab.
steps.expected: The first row is the product "(finished product)" with 2; then the parts for the third.

steps.action: Reserve and ship.
steps.expected: Two leave the product's stock, and the parts of one leave theirs.

cases.title: An order line asks for a variant
cases.preconditions: QA Hook with variants and stock of Red M only.

steps.action: Add a line for QA Hook without a variant.
steps.expected: Refused: the product comes in variants - say which.

steps.action: Type "red" as the variant where only one red variant has that word alone, or pick Colour=Red, Size=M.
steps.expected: The line is stored as "QA Hook, Colour=Red, Size=M".

steps.action: Add a second line for Colour=Blue, Size=M and reserve.
steps.expected: Refused: the blue ones are short. Nothing is reserved.

cases.title: Order confirmation, packing slip and invoice
cases.preconditions: A shipped order of a customer with an address.

steps.action: On the Stock tab press Print... > Order Confirmation.
steps.expected: A document with the customer's address, the lines, prices and the total, black on white.

steps.action: Choose Packing Slip.
steps.expected: Ordered / shipped / still to come, and no prices.

steps.action: In the document press Save as PDF... and open the file.
steps.expected: A PDF with the same content.

cases.title: What the open orders are short of
cases.preconditions: Two open orders that together need more of a part than is free; a template makes that part.

steps.action: Open Data > Order Shortages...
steps.expected: The sentence says how many parts are short; the part is listed with needed, free, short and both orders.

steps.action: Select it and press Plan Assembly...
steps.expected: A small dialog with a name and the missing quantity.

steps.action: Confirm.
steps.expected: The list says what was planned; "Being made" shows the quantity and the part is no longer to make.

suites.name: Purchasing
suites.description: Suppliers, purchase orders, receiving, the reorder list.

cases.title: Place a purchase order and receive it in two deliveries
cases.preconditions: A supplier and a part.

steps.action: Add a purchase order for the supplier with a line of 100 at 0.10. On the Receiving tab press Place Order.
steps.expected: Status Ordered; the lines cannot be changed.

steps.action: Press Receive..., type 60 and a location.
steps.expected: A new lot of 60 at 0.10; the line says received 60, outstanding 40.

steps.action: Receive 41.
steps.expected: Refused: only 40 is outstanding.

steps.action: Receive 40.
steps.expected: Status Received, with the date.

cases.title: Close an order whose rest is not coming
cases.preconditions: A placed order with something outstanding.

steps.action: Press Close...
steps.expected: A question is asked.

steps.action: Confirm.
steps.expected: Status Closed. What came in stays in stock.

cases.title: The reorder list and purchase orders made from it
cases.preconditions: A part with a reorder level of 30, a supplier, and 10 in stock.

steps.action: Open Data > Reorder List...
steps.expected: The part is listed: in stock 10, level 30, below by 20, to order 20.

steps.action: Press Create Purchase Orders... and confirm.
steps.expected: One open order for the supplier with a line of 20; the list says 20 "on open orders".

steps.action: Press Create Purchase Orders... again.
steps.expected: No order is made: the part is already on an open purchase order.

steps.action: Take the supplier off the part and try again with another part below its level.
steps.expected: It names the parts for which no supplier is said.

suites.name: Waste
suites.description: Kinds of waste, what a job wasted, the waste report.

cases.title: Waste with a material takes stock and costs
cases.preconditions: A waste type "Purge" for a printer model, a machine of that model put down for an assembly, filament in stock.

steps.action: On the assembly's Waste tab press Add Waste...: Purge, the filament as material, 20 g.
steps.expected: Listed with a cost; the filament's stock is 20 g less.

steps.action: Change the quantity to 30.
steps.expected: The stock is 30 g less than at the start; the cost follows.

steps.action: Delete the entry.
steps.expected: The stock is back.

cases.title: A batch's figure takes precedence over its assemblies'
cases.preconditions: A batch of two assemblies, each with waste of the same kind.

steps.action: Open the batch's Waste tab.
steps.expected: One row "added up from 2 assemblies".

steps.action: Edit that row and store it.
steps.expected: It becomes the batch's own figure; the assemblies' rows say "superseded by the batch".

steps.action: Open Data > Waste Report... for this year.
steps.expected: The kind shows the batch's figure for this month, not the sum of all three.

suites.name: Money and currency
suites.description: The server's currency, margins, the value of the stock, sales.

cases.title: Choose the currency
cases.preconditions: The server is running and you are logged in as an administrator.

steps.action: Open Server > Currency...
steps.expected: The currency in use is selected; Save is disabled. The dialog says that nothing is converted.

steps.action: Choose Euro.
steps.expected: The example reads "12.50 €" and Save is enabled.

steps.action: Save.
steps.expected: The status bar says amounts are shown in Euro now. The Products list shows prices with the sign.

steps.action: Edit a product.
steps.expected: The price field itself shows the plain number 12.50.

cases.title: The phone follows the currency
cases.preconditions: The currency was just changed on the desktop.

steps.action: On the phone log out and in, or reopen a page with amounts (a product's Inventory).
steps.expected: Amounts carry the new sign.

steps.action: Open the menu > Currency as an administrator.
steps.expected: The currency in use is chosen, with what an amount looks like.

cases.title: Margins
cases.preconditions: A product with a retail price of 10.00, finished stock at 5.00, and a variant with its own price of 15.00.

steps.action: Open Data > Product Money..., tab Margins.
steps.expected: The product: cost 5.00 from "the stock on the shelf", margin 5.00, 50.0%.

steps.action: Look at the variant's row under it.
steps.expected: Retail 15.00, margin 10.00, 66.7%.

steps.action: Look at a product without a price.
steps.expected: No margin; the note says it has no retail price.

cases.title: Stock value and sales by month
cases.preconditions: Finished stock, and at least one shipped order this year.

steps.action: Open the tab Stock Value.
steps.expected: Each shelf with something on it: pieces, value at cost and at retail prices; the sentence above adds them up.

steps.action: Open the tab Sales.
steps.expected: What was shipped this year by product and variant, with the pieces in the month's column and the amount.

steps.action: Set the year to one without sales.
steps.expected: "Nothing was shipped in <year>."

steps.action: Press Print... on a tab.
steps.expected: The tab as a document, to print or save as PDF.

suites.name: Several records at once
suites.description: Multi-selection: delete, parts into a template, assemblies into a batch.

cases.title: Delete several rows with one question
cases.preconditions: Three parts: two plain ones, and one with stock.

steps.action: In the Parts list click the first plain part and Ctrl+click the second. Press Del.
steps.expected: One question: "Delete 2 parts?" with both names; the button says Delete and Cancel is the default.

steps.action: Press Cancel, then Del again and Delete.
steps.expected: After Cancel nothing changed. After Delete both are gone and the status bar says 2 of 2 parts deleted.

steps.action: Select the part with stock and another part; press Del.
steps.expected: A warning lists what the first takes with it; the button says Delete All of It.

cases.title: Selected parts become a new assembly template
cases.preconditions: Three parts that no template uses.

steps.action: Select two of them (Shift or Ctrl). Right-click one and choose New Assembly Template of Selected...
steps.expected: A dialog names the two parts. Make Template is disabled.

steps.action: Type a name.
steps.expected: The Makes box fills in with the same name; the two selected parts are not offered in it.

steps.action: Type 2 into "Plan an assembly for" and press Make Template.
steps.expected: The browser shows the new template with both parts, one of each. A new part of that name exists and an assembly for 2 is planned.

cases.title: Selected parts are added to an existing template
cases.preconditions: A template, a part it has already, a part it has not, and the part it makes.

steps.action: Select the part it makes and choose Data > With the Selected > Add Parts to an Assembly Template...; pick the template.
steps.expected: Refused in the dialog: it is what the template makes. Nothing was added.

steps.action: Cancel. Select the two other parts and add them to the template.
steps.expected: The status bar says 1 part was added and that it had the other already.

cases.title: Selected assemblies become a batch
cases.preconditions: Three planned assemblies that are in no batch.

steps.action: In the Assemblies list select two and choose New Batch of Selected...; type a name and press Make Batch.
steps.expected: The browser shows the new batch; its Run tab lists the two.

steps.action: Select one of those two and the third; choose New Batch of Selected... and a name.
steps.expected: Refused in the dialog: one is in another batch. No batch was made - check the Assembly Batches list.

steps.action: Select the third alone and choose Add Selected to a Batch...; pick the batch.
steps.expected: It is added.

cases.title: Multi-select on the phone
cases.preconditions: Parts and assemblies as above.

steps.action: In the Parts list press and hold a row.
steps.expected: A bar appears over the list with "1 selected", Delete, New Template, Add to Template and Cancel; the add button is gone.

steps.action: Tap a second row, then tap it again.
steps.expected: "2 selected", then "1 selected".

steps.action: Tap Delete.
steps.expected: One question with the record's name (or "Delete 2 parts?") and what goes with it.

steps.action: Tap Cancel in the bar.
steps.expected: The bar goes; a tap opens a record again.

suites.name: The phone app
suites.description: What is particular to the phone.

cases.title: Browse, add and change a record
cases.preconditions: Logged in on the phone.

steps.action: Open Parts and tap a part.
steps.expected: Its page opens read-only.

steps.action: Tap the pencil, change the description and tap Save.
steps.expected: The page is read-only again with the new text.

steps.action: Go back and add a part with the round button.
steps.expected: The page closes once it is stored; the part is in the list.

steps.action: Open the part, start editing, change something and press Back.
steps.expected: It asks before discarding what was typed.

cases.title: Scan a barcode to find a record
cases.preconditions: A part whose part number is printed as a barcode.

steps.action: Open the menu > Scan Barcode and allow the camera.
steps.expected: The camera picture is shown.

steps.action: Scan the part's barcode.
steps.expected: The part's page opens.

steps.action: Scan a code nothing has.
steps.expected: It offers to add a part or a product with that number.

cases.title: Take a photo of a part
cases.preconditions: A part, opened for editing.

steps.action: Tap Images, then Take Photo.
steps.expected: The camera opens.

steps.action: Take the picture, give it a name and save.
steps.expected: The thumbnail is in the grid.

steps.action: Open the same part on the desktop: Data > Images of Selected...
steps.expected: The picture is there and can be viewed full size.

cases.title: Rotating and a wide window
cases.preconditions: Any record page.

steps.action: Turn the phone on its side.
steps.expected: The fields arrange in two columns; nothing is cut off.

steps.action: Turn it back.
steps.expected: One column again, with what was typed still there.

cases.title: The Back button
cases.preconditions: Several pages open.

steps.action: Press the phone's Back button.
steps.expected: The app goes back one page.

steps.action: Press Back on the first page.
steps.expected: The app closes (or goes to the background); it does not hang.

suites.name: The server
suites.description: Backups, the license, discovery, running as a service.

cases.title: Automatic backups and a backup by hand
cases.preconditions: The server is running and you are logged in as an administrator.

steps.action: Open Server > Database Backups...
steps.expected: The schedule (every 24 hours, keep 14), the folder, the last and the next backup, and the files.

steps.action: Press Back Up Now.
steps.expected: A new file FactoryBackup-<date>-<time>.sqlite is listed.

steps.action: Set "Keep the newest" to 1 and save.
steps.expected: Only the newest file is left.

steps.action: Put the schedule back.
steps.expected: Stored.

cases.title: Go back to a backup
cases.preconditions: A backup file made before a part was deleted. Access to the server's PC.

steps.action: Stop the service. Copy the backup file over the database file in the data folder. Start the service.
steps.expected: The service starts.

steps.action: Log in and look for the part.
steps.expected: It is there again, with its stock.

cases.title: The license in About
cases.preconditions: A server on the Free edition.

steps.action: Open Help > About.
steps.expected: Edition Free, the connections allowed and in use, and "At most 25 products".

steps.action: Press Apply License File... and choose a text file that is no license.
steps.expected: Refused with the server's reason; the edition stays Free.

steps.action: Stop the server and open About again.
steps.expected: It says the server is not available - not that the license is unknown or refused.

cases.title: Find the server on the network
cases.preconditions: App and server in the same network.

steps.action: In Server Settings press Find on Network.
steps.expected: After a few seconds the server is listed by name and address.

steps.action: Choose it.
steps.expected: The address box is filled in; nothing is saved or sent until Test Connection or OK.

cases.title: The server survives a restart of the PC
cases.preconditions: An installed server.

steps.action: Restart the PC and do not log in to Windows.
steps.expected: From another PC the desktop app can log in: the service started by itself.

steps.action: Log in to Windows and open the settings program.
steps.expected: Step 1 says the server is running.

cases.title: Two users change the same record
cases.preconditions: Two desktop apps logged in as different users (a license for two desktop connections).

steps.action: In both, open the same part and press Edit.
steps.expected: Both forms are editable.

steps.action: Save a new description in the first, then another in the second.
steps.expected: The second save is stored: the last one wins, and nobody gets an error.

steps.action: Press Refresh in the first.
steps.expected: It shows the second user's description.

suites.name: Look and feel
suites.description: Themes, fields, things that are easy to break.

cases.title: Light and dark
cases.preconditions: Windows set to the light mode.

steps.action: Choose View > Theme > Dark.
steps.expected: Every window and dialog is dark; no text is unreadable, error text is still told apart.

steps.action: Open a document (an order's Print...).
steps.expected: The document is black on white all the same.

steps.action: Choose System and switch Windows to dark and back.
steps.expected: The app follows without a restart.

cases.title: Hide a column and a field
cases.preconditions: The Parts list.

steps.action: Right-click the list's header and untick Description.
steps.expected: The column is gone; it stays gone after a restart.

steps.action: Open a part and use Fields to hide a row of the form.
steps.expected: The row is hidden; the value is still stored when the part is saved.

steps.action: Choose Show All in both.
steps.expected: Everything is back.

cases.title: Sort the list by a column
cases.preconditions: The Products list with several products in stock.

steps.action: Click the header "In stock".
steps.expected: The rows are sorted by the number, smallest first.

steps.action: Double-click the first row.
steps.expected: The form of that very product opens - not of the one that stood first before sorting.

steps.action: Click the header twice more.
steps.expected: Largest first, then back to the order by name.

cases.title: A record is made where it is chosen
cases.preconditions: A part without a category.

steps.action: Edit the part and press New... beside Category.
steps.expected: The dialog that adds a category opens over the form.

steps.action: Add "QA Category".
steps.expected: It is chosen in the box; what was typed in the form is still there.

steps.action: Save, then open Lists > Categories.
steps.expected: The category is listed.
